598:t_1:86.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(I'm counting on you to look after Her Highness $$ミネバ$$, $$バナージ$$...)

598:t_1:87.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(We'll be joining you there soon. Let's be sure to meet again alive.)

598:t_1:88.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「$$プトレマイオス２$$... has gone on ahead.」

598:t_1:89.en:
$$レイアム$$
「They'll use $$トランザム$$ to gain all the distance they can, and only then send out the $$ユニコーン$$...」

598:t_1:90.en:
$$オットー$$
「It's as good as using all of $c as decoys. It's bound to succeed.」

598:t_1:92.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain $$ジンネマン$$... We recovered the $$クシャトリヤ$$, but...」

598:t_1:93.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Put it to use in $c. She'd be happier that way.」

598:t_1:94.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then we'll take you up on that.」

598:t_1:95.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'm grateful, Captain $$オットー$$. For taking me aboard this ship.」

598:t_1:96.en:
$$オットー$$
「Don't mention it. You have a right to see how this ends too, Captain.」

598:t_1:97.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$インダストリアル７$$... Everything gets settled there...」

598:t_1:98.en:
$$オットー$$
「That place was also where it all began... Come to think of it, my association with you, Captain, dates back to that time.」

598:t_1:99.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I never imagined I'd meet the end of it on the bridge of this ship.」

598:t_1:101.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...If it hadn't been $$バナージ$$ riding the $$ユニコーン$$, I don't think things would have turned out like this.」

598:t_1:103.en:
$$オットー$$
「And now they are about to fulfill their mission, to put an end to everything.」

598:t_1:104.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(I'm counting on you to look after Her Highness $$ミネバ$$, $$バナージ$$... You are the very future that $$マリーダ$$ entrusted.)

598:t_1:105.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(We'll be joining you there soon. Let's be sure to meet again alive.)

598:t_2:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...So I've come here again...」

598:t_2:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Together with you, just like that time.」

598:t_2:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「A lot has happened up until today...」

598:t_2:7.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Days of fighting over the Box... But let's end it today.」

598:t_2:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Too many people have died... If $$ラプラスの箱$$ isn't worth that sacrifice...」

598:t_2:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...Whatever it is... whatever happens from here on... Promise me that you'll come back to me, no matter what...」

598:t_2:13.en:
???
「...I have been waiting... To convey just one thing...」

598:t_2:14.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「This voice... Who can it be...」

598:t_2:15.en:
???
「A descendant of my clan and the Princess of $$ジオン$$... There can be no one better suited to entrust $$ラプラスの箱$$ to...」

598:t_2:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you with the $$ビスト財団$$...?」

598:t_2:17.en:
???
「Life born of the sea took hundreds of millions of years to rise onto land... After several cycles of rise and fall, it needed still more ages to take human form.」

598:t_2:18.en:
???
「Evolution is like that. It cannot be felt within the lifespan given to an individual.」

598:t_2:20.en:
???
「...But a $$ニュータイプ$$ is an expansion of perception. It is said to prompt a transformation in an individual's consciousness...」

598:t_2:21.en:
???
「From those who believed in that infinite potential, on the last night of the A.D. era... at the very moment the $$宇宙世紀$$ began, it was spun into being.」

598:t_2:22.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The moment the $$宇宙世紀$$ began...?」

598:t_2:23.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「The terrorist attack at $$ラプラス$$, the $$地球連邦$$ prime minister's residence floating in space... Commonly known as the $$ラプラス事件$$...」

598:t_2:24.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「On the day the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter, which would set the direction of the new era, was to be announced... $$ラプラス$$ was blown up by someone...」

598:t_2:25.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Many member-state representatives, including the first Federation Prime Minister $$リカルド・マーセナス$$, died, and so the push to suppress anti-government movements grew...」

598:t_2:26.en:
???
「It could well be called the beginning of the bloodstained history of the $$宇宙世紀$$.」

598:t_2:27.en:
???
「But what was originally meant to be born there was a prayer for a new era.」

598:t_2:31.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's go, $$オードリー$$... To confirm everything with our own eyes.」

598:t_3:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Was it our world's fate to fight...?」

598:t_3:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's not it, $$オードリー$$.」

598:t_3:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It's true that we fought. But that was to open up the future.」

598:t_3:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$ガンダム$$ is guiding me... If I ride the $$ユニコーン$$, I can understand that.」

598:t_3:10.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's why we have to move forward in this battle.」

598:t_3:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I've seen it in a textbook... The monument of the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter...」

598:t_3:17.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But it's different from what we know...! There's one extra article!」

598:t_3:19.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...In the future, if the emergence of a new humanity adapted to space is recognized, they shall be given priority in taking part in running the government...」

598:t_3:20.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're saying this article was... deleted from the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter...?」

598:t_3:22.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You mean the $$ニュータイプ$$...?」

598:t_3:25.en:
$$サイアム$$
「It is the true nature of the curse that has bound us for so long. And... it is also a prayer...」

598:t_4:5.en:
$$ガエル$$
「This is $$サイアム・ビスト$$. The founder of the $$ビスト財団$$, and, $$バナージ$$... your great-grandfather.」

598:t_4:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You were watching, here...? The fight over the Box... You saw all of it, and you...!」

598:t_4:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$... You used $$ラプラスの箱$$... this true $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter... to draw favors out of the Federation for a long time.」

598:t_4:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Why, then, are you trying to give it up yourself now?」

598:t_4:11.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Because the time has come... Now, humanity advances to a new stage...」

598:t_4:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Beyond the civilization of fire...」

598:t_4:13.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Without despairing, without stagnating... A prayer to face, once more, the god named possibility... If we let this moment slip away...」
